books.title: 100 Facts About The Princes in the Tower
books.subtitle: Vanished for a Throne
books.description: Two young English princes were locked in the Tower of London in 1483 and never seen again. Their uncle became king. 100 royal facts about England's most chilling unsolved murder.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Sodder Children
books.subtitle: The Fire That Left No Graves
books.description: Five children vanished during a Christmas Eve house fire in 1945. No remains were ever found. Their parents never stopped believing they were alive. 100 heartbreaking facts about America's most haunting cold case.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Vatican Secret Archives
books.subtitle: History Behind Locked Doors
books.description: 85 kilometers of shelving, documents spanning 12 centuries, and access granted to almost nobody. 100 extraordinary facts about the most restricted library in human history.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Svalbard Vault
books.subtitle: Humanity's Backup for Doomsday
books.description: Buried inside an Arctic mountain on a remote Norwegian island sits the world's largest seed bank, designed to survive any catastrophe civilization can produce. 100 vital facts about humanity's ultimate insurance policy.

books.title: 100 Facts About Fort Knox
books.subtitle: The Stronghold of America's Reserves
books.description: The most secure building in America supposedly holds the nation's gold reserves. Nobody outside the government has verified it since 1974. 100 guarded facts about the vault everyone talks about and nobody gets inside.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Iron Mountain Vault
books.subtitle: Guarding History
books.description: A former limestone mine in Pennsylvania now stores the world's most irreplaceable records, from Hollywood masters to the DNA of extinct species. 100 fascinating facts about the facility holding civilization's backup copy.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Greenbrier Bunker
books.subtitle: Cold War Worries
books.description: For 30 years, a luxury five-star resort in West Virginia hid a fully equipped nuclear bunker designed to shelter the entire US Congress after an atomic attack. 100 classified facts about America's most elegant secret.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Death of Edgar Allan Poe
books.subtitle: Missing for Four Days
books.description: America's master of horror was found delirious on a Baltimore street in 1849, died four days later, and the cause was never established. 100 dark facts about literature's most mysterious death.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Death of Nikola Tesla
books.subtitle: His Life's Work Gone
books.description: The inventor who lit the world died alone in a New York hotel room and had his papers seized by government agents within hours. 100 electrifying facts about the genius whose secrets died with him.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Black Dahlia
books.subtitle: Broken Hollywood Dream
books.description: Elizabeth Short came to Hollywood with a dream and was found murdered in a vacant lot in 1947 in the most shocking crime scene LA had ever seen. 100 haunting facts about Hollywood's most famous unsolved murder.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Death of Elisa Lam
books.subtitle: Elevator to Nowhere
books.description: A 21-year-old tourist was found dead in a rooftop water tank at the Cecil Hotel after surveillance footage of her bizarre behavior in an elevator went viral worldwide. 100 unsettling facts about the case that haunted the internet.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Death of William Desmond Taylor
books.subtitle: The Director's Last Scene
books.description: Hollywood's most powerful director was shot dead in 1922, the investigation was immediately tampered with, and no one was ever charged. 100 glamorous and gritty facts about the murder that exposed old Hollywood's darkest secrets.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Nazi Gold Train
books.subtitle: The Golden Myth
books.description: A train loaded with Nazi gold, artwork, and treasure supposedly disappeared into a Polish mountain tunnel at the end of World War Two. 100 gripping facts about Europe's most hunted buried fortune.

books.title: 100 Facts About Operation Bernhard
books.subtitle: The Audacious Pound Plot
books.description: The Nazis forged over 130 million British pounds in the most ambitious counterfeiting operation in history, using concentration camp prisoners as the workforce. 100 shocking facts about the plot that nearly broke Britain's economy.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Quedlinburg Treasures
books.subtitle: Masterpieces Stolen in War
books.description: A Texas soldier packed priceless medieval relics into his duffel bag during World War Two and hid them in a Texas cave for decades. 100 extraordinary facts about the greatest art theft in American military history.

books.title: 100 Facts About Göring's Art Hoard
books.subtitle: Looting Europe's Soul
books.description: Hermann Göring personally looted over 1,300 masterpieces from across occupied Europe, building the greatest stolen art collection in history. 100 staggering facts about the Nazi who tried to steal a civilization's culture.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Merkers Mine
books.subtitle: The Nazi Gold Vault
books.description: In April 1945 American soldiers stumbled into a German salt mine packed with Nazi gold, currency, and looted art worth billions. 100 astonishing facts about the greatest single treasure discovery of World War Two.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Hope Diamond
books.subtitle: The Curse in Blue
books.description: The world's most famous gemstone has passed through the hands of kings, collectors, and thieves, leaving a trail of misfortune, madness, and death in its wake. 100 dazzling facts about the most cursed diamond in history.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Crying Boy Paintings
books.subtitle: Surviving the Inferno
books.description: Mass-produced portraits of crying children were reportedly found undamaged in the ruins of dozens of house fires across Britain in the 1980s. 100 eerie facts about the paintings the flames refused to destroy.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Dybbuk Box
books.subtitle: The Cabinet of Misfortune
books.description: A Jewish wine cabinet sold on eBay came with a warning, a history of nightmares, and a chain of owners who all reported the same terrifying experiences. 100 spine-chilling facts about the most haunted object ever listed online.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Delhi Purple Sapphire
books.subtitle: Fortune's Dark Jewel
books.description: Stolen from an Indian temple in 1857, this gemstone left a trail of illness, bankruptcy, and suicide among every owner until it was donated to a museum with a warning letter attached. 100 cursed facts about the gem nobody wanted to keep.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Basano Vase
books.subtitle: Silver Vessel of Doom
books.description: A 15th century Italian silver vase was found with a note warning of its curse. Four owners died shortly after acquiring it. A museum refused to accept it. 100 chilling facts about the vase nobody wants to own.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Ark of the Covenant
books.subtitle: Sacred Treasure Hunted Forever
books.description: The gold chest built to hold the Ten Commandments has been sought by armies, explorers, and governments for 2,500 years and has never been found. 100 extraordinary facts about history's most searched sacred object.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Holy Grail
books.subtitle: The Quest for Eternity
books.description: The cup used at the Last Supper has inspired crusades, obsessions, and centuries of searching by everyone from medieval knights to modern treasure hunters. 100 sacred facts about the most sought object in Western history.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Shroud of Turin
books.subtitle: Image Science Can't Explain
books.description: A linen cloth bearing the image of a crucified man has survived fires, wars, and centuries of scientific testing without producing a definitive answer. 100 remarkable facts about the burial cloth that keeps defeating science.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Spear of Destiny
books.subtitle: Lance of Divine Power
books.description: The Roman lance that pierced Jesus at the crucifixion has been claimed by Charlemagne, Napoleon, and Hitler, each believing it granted world domination. 100 powerful facts about the weapon every conqueror wanted to own.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Lost Tablets of Gilgamesh
books.subtitle: Epic Older Than the Bible
books.description: Clay tablets over 4,000 years old tell the story of a great flood, a search for immortality, and a hero's journey that predates every holy book on earth. 100 ancient facts about humanity's oldest written epic.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Lost Roman Legion
books.subtitle: Rome's Vanished Ninth
books.description: The Ninth Legion marched into northern Britain around 120 AD and was never recorded again. No battle, no surrender, no explanation. 100 gripping facts about Rome's most famous military disappearance.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Dancing Plague of 1518
books.subtitle: When a Town Danced For Weeks
books.description: In July 1518 a woman in Strasbourg began dancing uncontrollably. Within weeks hundreds had joined her and couldn't stop. Nobody knows why. 100 bizarre facts about history's strangest mass hysteria event.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Wow! Signal
books.subtitle: Echo of Extraterrestrial Contact
books.description: On August 15, 1977 a radio telescope detected a 72-second signal so powerful and so structured that the astronomer who found it wrote WOW in the margin. It has never been detected again. 100 cosmic facts about the most compelling evidence of alien contact ever recorded.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Taos Hum
books.subtitle: Mystery Sound Heard by Few
books.description: A persistent low-frequency hum has been heard by residents of Taos, New Mexico for decades. No source has ever been identified. 100 resonating facts about the sound that drives people to madness.

books.title: 100 Facts About The Green Children of Woolpit
books.subtitle: Medieval Tale of Strangers
books.description: Two green-skinned children appeared in a 12th century English village speaking an unknown language, eating only raw beans, and claiming to come from a land without sun. 100 extraordinary facts about history's most inexplicable arrival.
